name: Multi-dimensional Transfer Functions for 3D Flow Visualization
definition: A method to extract and track features in 3D flow fields by defining a transfer function based on vector field properties derived from vector calculus, specifically using velocity magnitude, velocity gradient tensor determinant, curl magnitude, helicity, and divergence to alleviate occlusion problems inherent in texture-based flow visualization.
summary: Multi-dimensional Transfer Functions map five scalar flow properties to RGBA values, distinguishing complex features better than standard methods that rely solely on velocity magnitude.
